[LSCP.2.5.7] The `ambient` modifier composes with a base lifecycle:
the base supplies lifecycle and identity, `ambient` supplies only the
read-only boundary ([LSCP.2.5.1] / [LSCP.2.5.3]). The populating source
drives assertion and retraction *within* the base lifecycle — for a
`logical` base, keyed upsert / one-live-per-key ([LFAC.1.7]); for a
`ttl` base, accumulation.
